notes: The margin Or, toward was read and set aside; the printed text's on the right side governs (rule 38).
בְּתוֹךְ is split because the ASV writes is in for the preposition and the middle for the construct noun; the copula joins the preposition as the clause's predicate (rules 2, 49).
נַחַל is tagged absolute, so the of before Gad is the relational word the ASV writes for the following name; the placement is the same one rule 19 would give a rectum.
